criteria.assessment: MV-valid accepts a broad typed graph and external references; MV-graph and MV-fields assert exact malformed, identity, edge, cardinality, cycle, lifecycle, history and nonmutation diagnostics; MV-refs exercises actual files, unsafe paths, canonical closure and concurrent input change. ME-batch adds actual guarded structural/lifecycle batch coverage.

unit.assessment: Three direct validation tests exercise representative model acceptance and isolated schema/graph/lifecycle/reference invariants with exact error IDs, paths and affected IDs.

integration.assessment: Filesystem-backed canonical references, transitive definition closure, path confinement and actual external edit during capture are exercised; guarded add-node/edge publication adds cross-file behavior.

criteria.assessment: ME-decision and ME-revise assert attributed resolution/history, revisions, blocker derivation, rejected/retired prerequisites, reopen behavior and transitive invalidation. ME-reject and ME-race prove rejected/stale writes preserve bytes and one compare-and-swap winner. ME-batch and the CLI journey cover guarded durable edits and reload.

unit.assessment: apply_batch is exercised directly for resolution, reopen/retire, transitive downstream invalidation, historical options, derived task states and immutability of input.

integration.assessment: Public commands and actual published files/generations prove invalid/stale refusal, race behavior and atomic guarded batch semantics.

e2e.assessment: The public CLI validates, admits, displays canonical scenario/test data, resolves a decision, reloads the ready task and rejects an invalid follow-up without changing bytes.

criteria.assessment: EV-real uses the shared completion evaluator on real disposable receipts/logs and asserts actual Given/When/Then, assertions, case/source identity, TDD, final outcomes and provenance while snapshotting files/mtimes. Tampering with behavior/static logs, receipts, runner identity, reviews, source and authority must not yield current completion. EV-missing covers absent/malformed/historical artifacts; the CLI journey inspects without promoting a link to completion.

integration.assessment: Cross-file coordinator evidence and Git authority are checked read-only; tamper and missing/historical cases assert state and artifact invariants.

e2e.assessment: The CLI journey exercises canonical assertion/test projection and decision flow with no current-completion inference from a test link; the integration evidence journey validates complete actual provenance.

criteria.assessment: MP-shared compares public JSON and Markdown IDs, snapshot digest, task/attention projections and absence of completion claims, and checks invalid focus plus last-validated noneditable output. MC-journey exercises public validate/admit/show/edit/reload and preserved data after an invalid edit.

integration.assessment: Public commands consume admitted repository files and compare machine/human projections against the same snapshot and state.

e2e.assessment: A complete subprocess CLI journey persists a reasoned decision and derived task state, reloads it, and rejects an invalid mutation without writes.

criteria.assessment: UI-inspect asserts scenario assertion/case content and unavailable/historical evidence without exposing hashes or expanded JSON. The AppTest suite checks scenario source, empty states, overview hierarchy and on-demand results; the browser journey inspects two scenarios, actual source, two evidence workstreams and honest candidate states. The UI consumes the admitted projection and does not implement graph validation/repair.

integration.assessment: AppTest checks actual rendered values and evidence states, candidate replacement, source details, and absence of eager evidence reads.

e2e.assessment: A temporary real browser/server journey exercises scenario selection, source inspection, evidence candidate inspection and two-session freshness behavior.

criteria.assessment: UI-persist checks attributed decision history and ready task across a fresh AppTest session. UI-conflict checks blank actor/rationale refusal and unchanged snapshot/open decision, stale linked-spec submission without writes, explicit refresh, successful resolution and reload. UI-browser repeats stale-form rejection and refresh/resolution/reload in actual browser contexts.

integration.assessment: AppTest verifies both invalid and valid form paths against persisted model identity and task projection.

e2e.assessment: Real two-context browser interaction proves stale-session refusal, explicit refresh, durable attributed resolution and task consequence after reload.

criteria.assessment: DG-pre proves invalid prestate stops before action; DG-post proves invalid candidate preserves stable generation; DG-refs checks stale linked inputs; DG-events exercises one-shot and native observer plus missed-event reads/actions; DG-parity compares cached/full results; DG-publish covers CAS, crash recovery and external-save interleaving; DG-bootstrap covers clean/invalid startup; DG-entrypoints probes public mutators; DG-success asserts exact step order and identities. integration.assessment: Actual filesystem, process, concurrency, cache/full comparison, rollback/recovery and mutator entrypoints are exercised at the guard boundary.
